scope: XR-2 conformance smoke followed by the exploratory pilot; no confirmatory or benchmark results claimed

scheduling.parallel_unit: independent frozen model seeds/arms or case shards; never change a matched arm's scientific limits

budget_accounting.rule: Sum allocated worker elapsed time, including failures and replacements. This is conservative under concurrency. Also retain actual CPU, allocated CPU/GPU/memory time, stage ledgers, and intervention token usage. Never replenish or raise a limit on resume.
budget_accounting.unsettled_attempt: Charge its outstanding reservation unless authoritative Slurm accounting justifies a recorded reconciliation.
budget_accounting.codex_authentication: existing ChatGPT login; token usage recorded separately, no API fallback or invented dollar estimate

work: Current component/reference/protocol conformance
HGT and matched R-GCN forward/backward on both GPUs
Complete generated smoke population with every clean-parent split and case outcome; label train/development only
batches.gate: Conformance passes; every requested case is accounted for. A usable complete development subset is required before model selection.

work: Train on the same saved teacher caches; use two GPU lanes
Select checkpoints using decoded development regret only
batches.gate: Versioned checkpoints, optimizer/RNG recovery, and explicit unavailable arms; no silent alternative selection criterion.

work: Freeze common inventories, objectives, policies, profiles and candidate coverage
Run action, exact/greedy, generation, pending/deadline, perturbation and simulated-preference controls
Safety/optimality replay and all-scheduled reporting
batches.gate: Contract conformance, not smoke model quality, determines progression. Preserve every unavailable/unknown outcome.

work: Prepare the complete pilot generated population from unchanged pilot.json
Retain mixed-family composition holdout, sibling grouping, partial teachers, and complete development coverage counts
batches.gate: Freeze preparation and split hashes before training; label all permitted cases within the original stage limits.

work: Audit available local input/release/import and provisional matcher-capture provenance
Prepare real-structure training/adaptation and held-out schedules as separate artifacts
requirements: Conference 2025 ra1, all 21 pairs and declared matcher strata
Bio-ML 2024 selected and 2026 whole releases kept separate
Explicit local clean/observed alignment supervision and permitted probes for adaptation
batches.gate: Missing licensed inputs or supervision are unavailable, never fabricated or inferred from hidden test labels. Request a decision by Gmail only when needed; generated work remains eligible.

work: Freeze the 18 generated-only configurations before training
Schedule equal scientific limits across matched configurations, within the remaining cumulative pilot budget
batches.gate: Freeze selected models before any held-out evaluation. Insufficient budget is recorded; changing it requires user approval.

work: Run matched finite-pool baselines, unary/pairwise scoring and proposal controls
Apply unchanged protocol candidate caps, size/deadline sweeps, score-noise and feature-dropout axes
Record retrieval, compilation, sampling, solver and verifier omissions separately
Evaluate default, declared simulated and nonnegative learned preference profiles using training-side simulated choices only
batches.gate: Fixed test population and external query basis; no held-out feedback into model selection or revised budgets.

work: Generated-only transfer versus separate training-side adaptation
Hold out ontology pairs and ekaw; report Bio-ML shared-ontology overlap
Run identical matcher captures and verification scope across compared arms
batches.gate: Use actual qualified reasoning capabilities, preserve unresolved/unsupported cases and partial-reference semantics.

work: Build paired grouped estimates, Holm adjustments, per-pair tables, verification/coverage tables and all-scheduled status records
Publish cumulative costs and all unavailable or budget-deferred work alongside successful runs
batches.gate: Reporting may finalize available independent cohorts while marking blocked cohorts unavailable; never mark unperformed studies complete.
